title.narrative: Philippines Sustainable Interventions in Biodiversity, Oceans and Landscapes (SIBOL)

description.narrative: (Philippines): .With Biodiversity and Sustainable Landscapes-earmarked funds, USAID, through the SIBOL activity, will improve natural resource governance, support sustainable management of natural resources, and reduce environmental crimes and unsustainable practices. USAID will develop and test biodiversity standards, metrics, and decision-making tools for improved protected area zoning and management. USAID will introduce tools to demonstrate how the natural capital accounts can inform decision-making related to natural resources management. ..USAID will also help analyze current policies and guidelines on: protected area community-based resource management; special land use agreement in protected areas; and setting up and operating ecotourism and biodiversity friendly enterprises, fishponds and aquaculture, and fishing rights...USAID will build community enforcement capacity to detect, record, analyze, and respond to environmental law violations. USAID will strengthen and incentivize community enforcement structures combined with behavior change campaigns against marine and terrestrial law violations and illegal wildlife trade. USAID will work with the U.S. Department of Justice and the Philippine judiciary to improve criminal prosecution of environmental cases and deter illegal activity...USAID aims to reduce one million tons of CO2 emissions over five years through land use planning; improved management of protected areas; mangrove rehabilitation; and community-based grants to promote natural climate solutions. USAID assistance will also improve the national forest monitoring system; and revise the national forest landscape restoration plan and the national community-based forest management strategy. .. .. .
